facts.note: The whole map is four hundred blocks east to west: the town, the flat and the body with sea round them.
Seven hundred and sixty blocks north to south: town, flat, black water, bank and body.
From y 30 under the sea floor to y 130 over the top of the head.
The coach road runs along the cliff top at y 96.
The harbour quays stand at y 66, four over the sea.
The flat's mud walk plane, one course over the sea water under it.
The top of the head, forty blocks over the flat.
The black water between the skiff stage and the body's bank is about sixty blocks wide.
The Pilgrims' Way runs at least two hundred and forty blocks from the slipway stair to the narrows.
The rib vault of the chest is thirty blocks high.
The ridge of the narrows is three blocks wide.
